name: Slack green deploys
ownerWords: look, YOUR JOB IS TO MAKE SURE THE SOFTWARE IS DURABLE. 자체적으로 고쳐질 수 있게 설계를 바꾸는게 니 역할이야
goal: Every slack-green main commit is live on the Railway worker (when it changes a railway.toml watch path) and on Vercel production within 20 minutes of its push. A miss heals without a hand fix, because the precheck deploys main's head to the worker once and the duty job fixes the cause in code so the miss does not repeat.

metrics.label: Main commits not live after 20 min

onMiss: If a source_error is flagged, fix the precheck or its login first, because the headline is unmeasured until then. For a commit in railway_not_live, redeploy main's head to the worker unless the redeploy flag shows the precheck did it this run. For a commit in vercel_not_live with no deployment, GitHub sent no push event, so push an empty commit through a PR, never `vercel redeploy`. Then start or steer one fix job on the cause, built as a PR, so it does not happen again. For a CI skip the cause is the failing check suite on that commit, and for a failed or stuck build it is the build log. If a live job already targets that cause (agent_observe.list_agents), message it the new commit and status instead of starting a second one. Tell the chat in one line with the commit, the side and the cause. Never merge, and never deploy anything but main's head.
